in_sanskrit.name: Najrul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Night Ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Najrul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Najrul is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nakta', meaning night. The name Najrul signifies the ruler of the night. It is a beautiful name for a baby boy, evoking images of tranquility, mystery and the beauty of the night sky.
